incidents.name: landNFT miner mint without permission check
incidents.notes: The miner contract's mint(address[],uint256[]) has no permission check, so the attacker minted 200 land NFTs to themselves and redeemed them for XQJ and then BUSD.

sources.ref: onchain review: miner 0x2e599883715D2f92468Fa5ae3F9aab4E930E3aC7 created 2023-03-06T09:48:58Z by 0xdd9e4fe7a975a637c29f3da23b2477ae1a9f8ad8, unrelated to attack sender 0x96b89c2560bcc43c342c12ba9c33dab7eb571a90; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. lossUsd uses the 149,616 BUSD reported by Beosin (BUSD taken at 1:1).
